issues.description: The problem statement and UML require addGuestStudents(int) (single int parameter), and the solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int). However, the template defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) with an extra boolean parameter. This signature mismatch will confuse students (they will implement the single-argument method as specified) and may cause compilation/test failures or ambiguity about the intended method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template method signature to match the specification and solution: change the template method to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) with an appropriate TODO body. If input validation is desired as a learning goal, either implement validation inside that single-argument method or add a separate private helper method; do not change the public API expected by the assignment and tests.
